A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING

Good questions.
Straight answers.

How does the guarantee work?+

We agree upfront what a booked appointment is and the window we're working to. If we don't book appointments into your calendar within that window, you don't pay our fee for that period. Advertising spend is separate and paid directly to the platform.

What does it cost?+

It depends on the campaigns and tools involved. You'll get a clear proposal before anything begins. Advertising spend is separate from our fee, and our fee is tied to the guarantee above.

Does AI replace the personal touch?+

No — it supports it. AI handles instant replies and routine follow-up so nobody waits, while you stay in control of the important conversations and every booked appointment.

Can you work with my calendar and tools?+

Yes. Bookings flow straight into your calendar and CRM, and where your other tools support it we connect them into the same journey. Anything that isn't possible, we'll tell you before we build.
